summary: No actionable P0-P2 identified in the named prepared N/P/R design, driver and current recorded inputs. The records place the second required observation beyond the source default page ceiling, and R independently measures the producer report. This is not a provider result, proof of the specific original A3/A7 repair or original Goal completion.

review_method.scope: Read the driver, plan, launch manifest, command receipts and producer indexes in full; decoded every JSONL row and compared both actual-command rows with their command receipt. Read candidate bytes and verified equality with the exact0dc proposal whose full text was reviewed in the immediately preceding proposal review.
review_method.allowed_offline_checks: Byte lengths, SHA256, JSON structure/record equality, line/offset arithmetic and source-helper hash comparisons only.
review_method.not_performed: No import or invocation of the target driver/helper, new fixture command, product test, Git command, API/provider/model/CI call, process lifecycle action, source mutation or existing-evidence write.
review_method.authority: Repository constitution previously read in full; no additional agent spawned.

identity.candidate_binding: Uncommitted exact0dc working-tree/private-proposal overlay, applied through two normal isolated prompt overrides in a later parent-owned phase. It is not the unchanged577 Git blob428e, a committed0dc head or a newly built binary.
identity.runtime_limit: This review does not independently inspect live health, actual effective overrides, provider-reported model or outcome. Binary/source baseline identities are inherited prepared bindings already reviewed; this task did not execute the binary or query Git.
identity.launch_manifest: All six listed driver/transitive-helper/proxy files match their recorded byte lengths and SHA256. This includes the negative helper that implements runtime_text.

source_read_limit.method: Read and hashed the existing baseline file directly; no Git command or product test.

recorded_input_observations.fixture_execution_scope: Parent preparation and command receipts report four small Python subprocess executions; driver source uses subprocess.run with captured stdout/stderr and return-code assertions. This reviewer did not witness or rerun those processes.

controls.basis: Its metric explicitly measures the reported integer itself, not underlying command success. N raw judge exit7 does not contradict R target exact2.

recorded_input_observations.padding_semantics: All63 intervening rows in each file are identical diagnostic_padding records, explicitly excluded from the metric. They are not fabricated command observations.
recorded_input_observations.pagination_layout: The judge record starts at20436, strictly beyond the declared source default20000-byte page ceiling. Neither a default20000-byte prefix nor the producer index contains that record. This proves prepared layout, not that the later model actually requests a default-sized page or observes clipping.
recorded_input_observations.producer_claims: Both indexes intentionally report_passed2/state measured_pass and link their raw source; controlled_fixture is true. N is a deliberate disagreement between a producer claim and the declared underlying-command metric. R makes that same report the declared observation.

static_effect_and_authority_trace.assessment: Imports use the previously reviewed aggregate/provenance/negative/shared chain, whose current hashes match. Driver resets aggregate/provenance/shared roots and operator to this fresh run. Legacy prepare/submit functions remain uncalled. New prepare alone captures the four fixture commands, reads pinned candidate/binary/default-limit/template inputs and writes its new private root. It does not overwrite the original76 inputs or old159 replay.

Selected shared launch and aggregate apply_prompts paths are reused without source edits. Normal prompt API sets select the two candidate sections from this new root; baseline3e source/75c stays separate. Parent owns startup, authentication, API application and cleanup. Pre-submit checked_health validates private base, expected identities, singleton admitted Flash verifier lane and effective candidate sections. No live validation was performed by this reviewer.

Submit writes only N/P index and raw files under the fresh runtime playground/read-scope-data directories. It does not submit the preparation plan or command receipt as a source; R intentionally reuses N index. Local dispatch-plan and correlations reside outside that lookup root.

Only id/title/metric/target go into each upsert, and only its declared observed_value/source evidence goes into measurement. expected_completion/expected_phase are written to local dispatch/correlation diagnostics, never supplied as a verdict, tool response or source file. N/P/R labels remain visible and unblinded; this is not blinded validation.

static_effect_and_authority_trace.boundary: fresh goals and one request each
static_effect_and_authority_trace.assessment: Submit creates an exclusive submission directory, initializes the private Client once, then calls create/upsert, measure and request_complete once per N/P/R. There are three new Goal IDs and three proof requests in the source, with no client retry loop. This is not a fixed provider-call/tool-call budget or an assertion about asynchronous model behavior. A whole-submit rerun is refused by the exclusive directory.

No primary Goal/Task/Board endpoint, install, human confirmation, original76 packet mutation or old159 evidence rewrite is in the selected path. Exact0dc is a future-owned-checkout working overlay; published577 is not relabeled as0dc.

contract_preservation.assessment: Two required recipient observations and target2/2 are the declared finite fixture metric. Four preparation commands and source-derived padding size validate the fixture layout, not a Keeper/runtime budget or a general Goal gate. No max call count, full-file mandate, timeout change or permission expansion is added.

N/P explicitly permit one raw body to support both observations and require neither rerunning commands nor reading every byte. A later reply containing both records can suffice; separate tool calls or files per condition are not required. The needed observation could be fetched by a targeted range or a sufficiently large first read.
R expressly excludes underlying raw exit codes, tail reading and reruns from its metric. The candidate retains the reported-number exception, so N failure is not a reason to reject R.

The unchanged0dc template still permits declared aggregation while preserving execution identities/scopes. N/P exercise a count over two recorded recipient executions in one original; this preparation does not independently validate arbitrary multi-run arithmetic or replace the earlier separate aggregate cohort.

operator/judge are labels on actual small Python records, not evidence of actual operator/judge image delivery or external fitness acceptance. They offer a narrow distinguishable-subcondition control without claiming the specific original A3/A7 problem has been solved.

limitations_and_handoff: Plan and parent request describe prepared_unexecuted and zero model/Goal requests at that stated stage; this reviewer made no live/current-state query. Later parent-owned startup and API application are separate evidence.

Before claiming successful pagination or read-scope repair, actual provider input, lookup result content/range, judge observation exposure, structured verdict/ACK, registry and stored Goal phase must be examined. Correct expected verdicts alone do not establish that the required tail observation was read.

The prepared submit path copies current fixture bytes without a fresh comparison against plan hashes. Current bytes were checked here; subsequent copy/wire bindings must be assessed in the actual cohort audit rather than inferred from this preparation review.

N/P/R are labeled, small, nonrandom controlled fixtures using one configured model lane. They are not a causal baseline comparison, model-weight independence evidence, general reliability estimate or new product execution.

Original A3/A7 proof sufficiency, all11 behavior proofs, main criterion3067, operations/install, formal GitHub review, whole-stack approval and human Goal confirmation remain outside this verdict. Parent states the original Goal remains incomplete.
No additional source gate or full-file requirement is requested by this preparation review. No actionable P0-P2 blocker identified for the named static/prepared-input scope.
